statement.pretty:
NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph →
  NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.ParamStore ℝ →
    Std.HashMap ℕ NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.Val →
      ℕ → Array (Option NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.Val)

∀ (g : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph) (ps : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.ParamStore ℝ)
  (inputs : Std.HashMap ℕ NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.Val) (x : ℕ),
  NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalGraphPrefix g ps inputs x =
    match x with
    | 0 => Array.replicate g.nodes.size none
    | n.succ =>
      have acc := NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalGraphPrefix g ps inputs n;
      acc.set! n (NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalNode? g.nodes ps inputs acc n)

conclusion.pretty:
NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalGraphPrefix g ps inputs x✝ =
  match x✝ with
  | 0 => Array.replicate g.nodes.size none
  | n.succ =>
    have acc := NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalGraphPrefix g ps inputs n;
    acc.set! n (NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalNode? g.nodes ps inputs acc n)

declarations.name: NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalGraphRec
declarations.docstring: Evaluate all nodes of `g` in id order, returning the final value array.

statement.pretty:
∀ (g : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph) (ps : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.ParamStore ℝ)
  (inputs : Std.HashMap ℕ NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.Val),
  NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.TopoSorted g →

NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.SemLocalOK g ps inputs

declarations.name: NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.runIBP?
declarations.docstring: Run the safe IBP checker step across the full graph, producing a per-node certificate array.

statement.pretty:
∀ (g : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph) (ps : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.ParamStore ℝ),
  NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.TopoSorted g →
    NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.CertLocalOK g ps (NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.runIBP? g ps)

declarations.name: NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.runIBP?_CertLocalOK
declarations.docstring: Under topological order, the certificate produced by `runIBP?` satisfies `CertLocalOK`.

statement.pretty:
∀ (g : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph) (ps : NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.ParamStore ℝ)
  (inputs : Std.HashMap ℕ NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.Val),
  NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.TopoSorted g →
    NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.Supported g →
      NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.InputsEnclosed g ps inputs →
        ∀ id < g.nodes.size,
          match (NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.runIBP? g ps)[id]!,
            (NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalGraphRec g ps inputs)[id]! with
          | some B, some v => NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.EnclosesBox B v
          | x, x_1 => True

conclusion.pretty:
match (NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.runIBP? g ps)[id]!,
  (NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.evalGraphRec g ps inputs)[id]! with
| some B, some v => NN.MLTheory.CROWN.Graph.CertSoundness.EnclosesBox B v
| x, x_1 => True
